title: dactylorhiza × grandis nothosubsp. robustior
intro: Dactylorhiza × grandis nothosubsp. robustior, commonly known as the robust Dactylorhiza hybrid, is a plant species that results from the natural hybridization between Dactylorhiza grandis and Dactylorhiza maculata. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and combat bacterial infections. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × grandis nothosubsp. robustior include its ability to calm and soothe the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, such as kaempferol, quercetin, and genistein, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
